lines.speaker: Goliath
lines.text: A boy? Do you take me for a dog, coming at me with a shepherd's staff?

lines.speaker: Goliath
lines.text: Come closer! Today you will fall before me!

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: You come with sword and spear. I come in the name of the Lord, the God of the armies of Israel.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: This battle belongs to the Lord. He does not need sword or spear to save us.

lines.speaker: Soldier
lines.text: Quiet. The shepherd is facing him.
